artworks.title: Diana Mourning the Death of Orion
artworks.description: This drawing depicts a mythological scene with a landscape and figures. The detailed composition includes multiple figures engaged in various activities. In the foreground, a group of people are shown with one figure lying on the ground, surrounded by attendants or mourners. In the sky, a figure is seen riding a chariot pulled by animals. The background features a lush landscape with trees, a cityscape, and a body of water with boats. The drawing combines elements of emotion, mythology, and landscape.

artworks.title: Venus Extracting a Thorn from Her Foot
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a woman seated in a naturalistic setting. The drawing features a nude figure seated on a draped cloth in a lush, wooded landscape. Surrounding her are dense clusters of foliage, a palm tree, and a rabbit nestled among the leaves. The scene extends into a tranquil landscape with rocky hills and a distant view of a building on cliffs. The artwork is detailed with cross-hatching techniques.

artworks.title: Comte Lepic
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated with one leg crossed over the other. He is turned slightly to one side with his hands resting on his knee. The man has a full beard and mustache, curly hair, and wears a suit. Behind him is an easel with a canvas and a sketch of a dog on the wall. The background is lightly sketched with various lines and shadings. The signature "Camille Lepage" is in the bottom left corner of the sketch.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Man
artworks.description: The image is a profile portrait of a man. The man is facing left with his head slightly angled forward. His hair is short and wavy, fading into a more textured pattern at the back of his head. His facial features include a pronounced nose and a focused gaze. He is dressed in formal attire, likely a coat with a high, starched collar, and there is a visible decorative element on his shoulder, possibly an epaulet. The background of the image is plain. The drawing is signed and dated with "1816" marked beneath the signature.

artworks.title: Sappho
artworks.description: This is a detailed drawing of a forest scene. The drawing shows the outline of a figure holding a basket, walking through a grove of birch trees with a river or pond in the background. The drawing uses delicate lines to depict the scene under a crescent moon. There are floral details scattered around, enhancing the pastoral setting.

artworks.title: The Betrothal of Philip the Fair with Joan of Castile
artworks.description: The image is a black-and-white drawing portraying three full-body figures standing. The two figures on the left face slightly toward the right, while the figure on the right faces the others, holding a book-like object with both hands. The two figures on the left are crowned and wear lavish robes lined with fur and ornate patterns. They both hold scepters, and the man standing on the far left has long hair cascading under his crown. The person in the middle has long flowing hair. The figure on the right wears an ornately patterned robe and a smaller crown, with short stylized hair visible beneath it. This figure's robe features intricate designs and heraldic emblems. Behind them is an elaborate backdrop of patterned drapery. The floor consists of a tiled surface, with a section of the wall and a column visible on the right. The background includes an arched window casting light onto the scene.

artworks.title: Printed text for "The Betrothal of Philip the Fair with Joan of Castile"
artworks.description: This is a photograph of a piece of old printed text. The image features a small section of a printed page with German text written in an ornate blackletter font. The text is framed on the left and bottom by decorative lines and swirls. The number "13" appears at the top left corner of the image. The background is a light beige color.

artworks.title: The Betrothal of Maximilian with Mary of Burgundy
artworks.dimensions: image (trimmed within block): 17.4 x 15.8 cm (6 7/8 x 6 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows two full-length figures facing each other. On the left, a person stands wearing ornate armor, including a detailed chest piece and segmented plate skirt, with a crown on their head and long hair visible. On the right, another person stands holding a shield with intricate heraldic designs, dressed in elegantly patterned robes, also crowned, with shorter hair visible. The background is richly decorated with floral and geometric motifs, in a regal room with a checkered floor and ornate detailing.

artworks.title: Printed text for "The Betrothal of Maximilian with Mary of Burgundy"
artworks.description: This is a photograph of a printed text section with decorative border elements. The image features a block of Gothic or Blackletter style text laid out in lines of uniform width, with a decorative border on the left consisting of vertical lines, scrolls, and curved elements. The text appears to be German, displayed in a classic typeface often associated with historical or medieval documents. The background is a light, aged paper color.

artworks.title: The Rhinoceros
artworks.medium: woodcut and letterpress on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to image): 23.5 x 29.8 cm (9 1/4 x 11 3/4 in.)
artworks.description: Printed with black lines on cream-white paper, a rhinoceros facing our right in profile fills this horizontal woodcut. The rhinoceros’s horn touches the border to the right and its hindquarters the left. Its left foot, farther from us, stands slightly ahead of its right hoof. Its front feet are close together and its head is lowered. Chunky, armor-like plates covering its body are patterned in some areas, especially on its legs and belly, with rings and dots, creating a mottled effect. The skin on its legs is scaly like a fish or reptile. A short, twisted, unicorn-like horn grows from between its shoulders, and the animal’s lower lip and the ear we see is fuzzy with short hairs. Near the upper right, in the corner near the animal's shoulders, the print is inscribed, “1515 RHINOCERVS.” Below, the artist’s initials appear as a monogram, with an upper case D tucked within the legs of an A. Five rows of tightly spaced German writing runs across the top edge of the paper, above the single-line border framing the animal. It reads, "Nach Christus gepurt. 1513. Jar. Adi. 1. May. Hat man dem groszmechtigen Kunig von Portugall Emanuell gen Lysabona pracht ausz India ein sollich lebendig Thier. Das nennen sie Rhinocerus. Das ist hye mit aller seiner gestalt Abconderfet. Es hat ein farb wie ein gespreckelte Schildtkrot. Und ist von dicken Schalen uberlegt fast fest. Und ist in der grösz als der Helfandt Aber nydertrechtiger von paynen und fast werhafftig. Es hat ein scharff starck Horn vorn auff der nasen Das Begyndt es albeg zu werzen wo es Bey staynen ist. Das dosig Thier ist des Helffantz todt feyndt. Der Helffandt furcht es fast ubel dann wo es In ankumbt so laufft Im das Thier mit dem kopff zwischen dye fordern payn und reyst den Helffandt unden am pauch auff un erwürgt In des mag er sich nit erwern. Dann das Thier ist also gewapent das Im der Helffandt nichts kan thun. Sie sagen auch das der Rhynocerus Schnell Fraydig und Listig sey."

artworks.title: Woman Carrying a Basket on Her Head
artworks.description: The sculpture features a figure resembling a classical or mythological character with a partially draped and muscular torso standing on a simple base. The figure wears a headdress made of fruits and leaves. Beside the central figure, two decorative elements hang from curved structures resembling vessels with what seems to be smoke or steam rising. Below, two symmetrical ornamental vases with floral motifs, each featuring a human-like face with wings flank the figure. The overall composition appears elaborately detailed, emphasizing historical artwork intricacies.

artworks.title: Satyr Bending Towards the Right
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a figure composed of various elements including a muscular torso, a twisted column, and decorative ornaments. The central figure appears to be a hybrid of architectural and human elements with a bearded, horned mask-like face positioned above a twisted column resembling a torso. This torso is flanked by ornate scrolls featuring carved human faces. Above, there is a draped canopy. On either side, there are decorative objects resembling helmets or armor, with ribbons and laurel accents. The base features a basket overflowing with fruits. The composition blends human, architectural, and natural motifs in a surreal manner.

artworks.title: Woman with Musical Instrument
artworks.description: The image shows a figure in elaborate attire standing under a canopy. The figure's robes are detailed and flowing. Above them, an ornate canopy is decorated and hangs. The figure holds an object and a musical instrument by their side. The background includes decorative elements like a potted plant and columns. The image uses shading and line work for depth.

artworks.title: Man in a Niche
artworks.description: This image depicts a sculpture with a male figure. The design features a symmetrical composition with a muscular male torso merging into decorative elements. The figure wears a headdress with seaweed-like details. The sculpture is surrounded by hanging chains with matching motifs. A mask-like face is at the top, and another face is at the bottom of the design.

artworks.title: Horned Genius
artworks.description: The image features an interplay of curves and angles creating abstract shapes. In the center, a figure with a muscular torso wraps its legs into a spiral resembling a vine or serpent, leading into a vase of fruits and foliage. The head is adorned with curling horns forming a crown-like structure. Flanking the figure are cherubic forms playing musical instruments, while geometric patterns hang from an overhead framework, connecting to objects resembling weights or ornaments. The overall composition merges elements of mythology and nature, drawing parallels to figures such as fauns or deities of abundance.

artworks.title: Woman's Head on a Pedestal
artworks.description: The image shows an abstract figure with a long, spiraled column base topped by a bust resembling a human face. The figure is crowned with leaf-like patterns, and on either side of the column, there are symmetrical arrangements of fruit and foliage hanging from delicate strings. Below these, to the left and right, there are two abstract winged insects.

artworks.title: Hercules with His Club
artworks.description: The figure stands behind a rectangular pedestal, extending from head to mid-thigh. The person has a bearded face, curly hair, and a serious expression. They wear loose garments, with a hand-woven lion pelt draped over one shoulder. The lion's head rests on their chest, and they hold a large club-like object with one hand. The background includes tall grass, a small stream, and a leafless tree on the right. Above the figure, ornate designs frame the scene, with leafy garlands, tassels, and ornamental faces with wings.

artworks.title: Sphinx Wearing a Crescent on Her Head
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a mythical or fantastical figure with ornamental designs. The central figure is a stylized embodiment that merges human and architectural elements, featuring a human-like face with elaborate, geometric and organic shapes forming the body. The figure is highly symmetrical, standing on what appears to be a pedestal. It is adorned with intricate floral and vine-like motifs extending outward. These elements suggest a blend of human form with floral and decorative design. The entire composition is framed in an oval shape.

artworks.title: Bearded Head on a Pedestal
artworks.description: This drawing depicts an intricately designed heraldic figure. A central human bust with a bearded male visage sits atop a pedestalesque construct adorned with decorative scrollwork and hanging tassels. Crossed swords, each adorned with circular shields, extend from either side of the bust. Suspended from the swords are garlands that include various botanical elements such as leaves, vines, and possibly fruits. The piece is rich in detail with intricate shading, creating texture and depth, giving it a primarily ornamental and emblematic appearance.

artworks.title: Diana of Ephesus
artworks.description: The image depicts a figure from the waist up, centrally positioned and facing mostly forward with a slight turn of the head to the side. The person's facial features are finely detailed with soft expressions and delicate, flowing hair that is long and wavy, cascading down past the shoulders. They wear intricate robes, with the upper garment resembling a draped cloth covering most of the chest and arms, while the lower part consists of detailed patterns resembling scales or spheres. The surroundings include decorative elements like fantastical creatures resembling lobsters and bats, a fortress or castle-like structure on the person's head, and additional floral and ornamental swirls with human faces and birds. The background is a textured canvas, adding aged character to the detailed design.

artworks.title: Woman with Left Profile
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved illustration of a sculpture of a classical female figure. The figure is partially draped in flowing fabric, standing in a contrapposto pose. The engraving is monochromatic, with varying shades of black and grey. The figure stands on an ornate pedestal with decorative elements. Floral and faunal motifs surround the sculpture, including garlands, swans, and curling vines. The sculpture faces slightly to the left with its head tilted downwards.

artworks.title: Satyr with Twisted Legs
artworks.description: There is a drawing of a mythical figure. The central figure has a human torso and a goat head with horns and a beard. The figure stands on a twisted column with decorative elements like a lion mask at the base. The figure holds a bowl or platter on its head with botanical elements spilling over. On each side, there are hanging shields with animal faces. The background shows a stone archway and wall. The drawing has intricate details and a mystical tone, similar to Renaissance artwork.

artworks.title: Pan
artworks.description: The image is an engraving of a mythical figure standing upright on a pedestal. The figure has the legs and hooves of an animal resembling a satyr, with a full, curly beard, short, curly hair, and a flat object on top. They wear a draped garment covering their torso, revealing textured legs. The figure holds panpipes in one hand. The background has a line design with clusters of fruits and leaves tied with ribbons on each side. The scene is framed within an oval shape on a textured surface.

artworks.title: Old Man Warming His Hands
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing in an elegant pose with one arm extended forward. His head is slightly tilted. He has a long beard, wears a close-fitting cap, and voluminous robes that flow to the floor. Surrounding him are an oval mirror-like object, sconces with flames, a large urn, a scroll or cylindrical object, and a decorative mounting at his feet. The background is detailed with line work.
